label: Sheet Treatment
description: Technical-presentation treatments for machines — every item is a complete graphic language: ground, linework, annotation style.

items.name: cyanotype-blueprint
items.text: rendered as a cyanotype blueprint, crisp white linework on Prussian-blue ground, three orthographic views tied together with dimension chains and a ruled title block

items.name: patent-plate
items.text: rendered as a vintage patent-office plate, fine hatched shading, numbered leader lines and serif figure captions on toned archival paper

items.name: exploded-isometric
items.text: rendered as an exploded isometric diagram, components floated apart along dotted assembly axes, each part numbered against a keyed legend

items.name: ghosted-cutaway
items.text: rendered as an airbrushed ghost cutaway, the outer skin faded to glass over a fully drawn drivetrain, structure and interior

items.name: service-manual
items.text: rendered as a factory service-manual page, bold numbered callouts, torque tables and caution boxes set into the margins

items.name: wind-tunnel-report
items.text: rendered as an aerodynamic test report, CFD streamlines combed over the body, a false-color pressure map and instrument data blocks along the footer

items.name: homologation-sheet
items.text: rendered as a period homologation document, side elevation over a dimension grid, stamped approvals and typewritten specification rows

items.name: catalog-plate
items.text: rendered as a collection catalog plate, the machine floated on archival cream with italic specification footnotes and a small provenance map

items.name: restoration-survey
items.text: rendered as a restoration survey board, a master drawing ringed by paint-depth readings, taped material swatches and pinned inspection photographs
